title: Add Check Boxes to Event Description field
body: I think there should be  Check Boxes option in the  Event Description field so that one can remember what he planned to do at each event and check them out on the go
author: nature_ncs

title: TODAY'S DATE ON ICON
body: Despite all the features I prefer in my Google Calendar over alternatives, the reason it still isn't my main is because the calendar icon doesn't show the day's date. I've found that that's a major inconvenience for me having to open the app before checking today's date. My current main calendar's icon changes everyday and gives me a convenient update at one glance. If this is something Google can look into, I'm sure it'll really help UX.
author: Tiemitayo

title: Good app
body: Is there a way to add the draft function on google calendar? Imagine I want to setup a meeting but I’m not sure of the time and I’ve added 10 emails, but  I urgently need to set up another meeting invite. it means I have to discard the previous meeting setup to attend to the new one, making me start the whole process all over again. Please add a draft function so that it’s easy to set up meetings
author: piagetskinner

title: Widget Responsiveness
body: The calendar widget is not very responsive. I mean responsive in terms of speed of synchronisation with the actual app. I always have to open the calendar app for events in my calendar to show up in the widget .
author: ugookoro

title: Great and so great App but some really sad things in there
body:
Please the big plus button at the down right corner blocks my capacity to interact with the calendar sometimes and it’s really not cool so please have a mechanism that has it go when I want and come when I do, or just have it a better place

Also... please when I am using objectives to build habits it’s really really not cool that if I want my objective to be on every Saturday but that the month ends on Thursday, the calendar with automation will throw my objective on whatever day between Monday to Thursday and not Saturday of that week because the calendar considers that as we draw into another month the same week is actually 2 different weeks. I can correct that manually but the point here is growing automation to easy our lives.

Please I also know you wish to maximize the use of artificial intelligence but it sometimes actually gives more work to keep on changing the time of the objectives over over because the calendar happens not to learn very fast all the time. So pls add some Manual stuff in the place where we are regulating the time occurrence of objectives. Like say for example: let us fix time. “Morning Afternoon Evening “, it’s good but fixing time right off is better

Please on the calendar we are allowed to see our activity from 00:00 to 23:59 and it’s great but please give us opportunity tu regulate how much of the page we want to see. I’d be really good with 6:00-23:59 most of the time, I’d love to spare my screen
author: oliverc619

title: Synchronize google calendar and Tasks on mobile!
body:
Hello, I love google but I find it strange that google calendar and tasks do not function together on mobile.
 I don’t see my curated tasks on the mobile calendar. It quite goes against what google stands for -ease of access, don’t you think so?
Please fix it. There’s a whole community of humans that needs this feature
